BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Imitacia!!
It took long but we are safe here... Oh, sorry\nfor not introducing myself. I am Grecia the\nGoddess of Courage. Welcome to the Dark Realm...
Human bodies are recognized as unclean here.\nSo, they are dissolved by the force working\nall over the land.
No worries.\nI've stopped the effect on you with my power...
The Dark Realm? Bodies are dissolved?\nWhat kind of place is here...?
Haven't you heard of the Dark Realm?\nHere, the Dark Realm is governed by Dunkelis\nthe Goddess of Darkness.
Souls of the dead that departed from the human\nworld rest here until they are given next life...
[Souls of the dead] rest here...\nShe means you're [dead]?!
You don't need to rush... You are dead from\nhumans' point of view since you're here.\nHowever, it's still possible to come back to life.
I felt horribly dark mind attacking a person of\ncourage, and headed for Calle Mort.\nThen, I found you critically injured.
So, I brought your body to here before your life\ncompletely flickers out so you can survive...
Calm down... See, I can stop the dissolution\neffect on your body. Your soul was almost leaving\nfrom your body because of the damage, so...
To prevent your death, I had to bring you to here\nso that I can fully use my divine power to restore\nyour body...
Sounds like you were saved but...\nYou were taken to the place beyond imagination...
No wonder you are confused.\nOrdinary living humans cannot come to the Dark\nRealm.
I know there are too many things beyond your\nunderstanding. Ask me any question.\nI'll answer everything I know.
What was the monster in Lunagent...?
What was the battle I saw?
Tell me about the Dark Realm.
Are you alone in this castle?
I have no questions.
...The unknown existence that attacked you?\nI'm sorry I've never seen it either...\nI assume it came from outside the human world...
In addition to its attack abilities, the creature\nhas extraordinarily dark will... It was different\nfrom evil and I couldn't read any intention or
feeling from it. I've never felt that kind of\nwill in the human world. It's gone after I shot\nan arrow when I found you but...
They both are soldiers of darkness who protect\nthis land under the command of Halios and\nVatendeth the Dark General but...
Suddenly, some soldiers got black thorns or horns\nand began to attack allies. The battle you saw\nwas just a glimpse of it...
Quite a few soldiers mutated before Vatendeth\nthe General noticed, and now the original soldiers\nare being overwhelmed by numbers...
As I said, the Dark Realm is the place where\nsouls of the dead return after departing from\nthe human world.
It's adjacent to the human world but living people\ncannot enter except in rare circumstances...
...Ha ha. It's not something like that.\nFor humans, the Dark Realm may sound like\na place where evil existences lurking but...
Actually, the land is managed by Dunkelis the\nGoddess of Darkness and souls rest in quiet\npeace until they rebirth.
...It's true that darkness lures the evil.
So, the Dark Troop led by Vatendeth the Dark\nGeneral and Halios protect the land with Dunkelis\nbut...
No, Dunkelis the Goddess of Darkness, who is\nmanaging this land, Vatendeth the General of\nthe Dark Troop, and Halios are usually here.
But the Dark Manor in which Dunkelis live was\noccupied by the mutant soldiers. Dunkelis\nand Vatendeth went to regain the manor. However...
They were surrounded by the mutant soldiers\nand isolated. Halios went to rescue them but he\nwent missing...
...Did you understand about the Dark Realm?\n...Alright. The friendly attack of the dark\nsoldiers is a big problem already but...
Now that the mutant soldiers are deployed all\nover the Dark Realm, Halios and his subordinates\nare engaging in battles at each facility.
But the Dark Manor, one of our most important\nstrongholds was occupied during their fight.\nThis is really something grave...
...What? Oh, sorry. I didn't explain well enough.\nThe Dark Manor, Dunkelis' throne stabilizes and\nmaintains the Dark Realm.
After it was occupied, the Realm is getting\nunstable and the border between the two worlds is\nabout to disappear... Can you guess what it means?
Right... If the Dark Realm and the human world\nwere connected, the mutant soldiers would\nroll into the human world and attack people...
Obviously, the problem is not just about the Dark\nRealm and it may threaten the human world...
The dark captains fighting in each place don't\nknow that Dunkelis and Vatendeth got stuck at\nthe Cradle of Soldiers yet and...
we are not sure if we have enough troops to rescue\nthem... I myself have to protect the castle and\nsoldiers here. What am I supposed to do for them?
You go there?! No way!!\nYou're injured and your body is still unstable,\nyou know?!
Your body is stable now because you are within\nthe range of my power!
If you go too far away from me, the dissolution\nmay start again... I appreciate your offer\nbut I can't accept it!
...What? Dunkelis?\nShe's the ruler of the Dark Realm, so it should\nbe easy for her to stop the dissolution...
Don't say... You'll reach the Cradle of Soldiers\nbefore your body is completely dissolved?!\nThat's too reckless...
I can tell by your eyes that you're determined\nto do that...I know the Goddess of Courage must\nrespond to it.
I'll ask Dunkelis to send you back to the human\nworld after the situation in the Dark Realm is\nsettled. So, please give us a hand until then!
I really appreciate your help.
First of all, I'd like you to rescue Dunkelis and\nVatendeth from the transformed soldiers, and...
Goddess Grecia!\nOur defense line has been defeated and the\nmutant soldiers are coming into the castle!!
What the...
We'll handle them.\nPlease go rescue them.
They should be at the place called the Cradle of\nSoldiers... Go, right now!!
Whoa?! L-Look! It's Grecia!!
You?! How blasphemous to imitate Grecia...\nYou'll get punished for that!!
Not only her appearance.\nI copied the power of the goddess.\nYou are no match for me.
Eek!! Wait, wait, wait!!
Funny.\nLet's see if a false goddess can beat us!!
Y-You blasphemous idiooots!!
You are not a deity...\nRegret for stealing the power that is beyond\nyour means...
M-My power! N-No! It's crushing my...\nGuarrrggghh!!
An inflated balloon bursts just by piercing a tiny\nhole...
Since the body was penetrated by the sword,\nthe formidable power inside the body blew out\nand crushed the enemy...
I'm sorry but I can't move for a while.\nSave Grecia.
Hold it until you save Grecia!
You are...!\nWhat has become of Dunkelis?!\nIs she alright?!
So, you are... No!!
Hey, Ma'am Grecia, Sir Vatendeth, and human\nadventurer! Are you guys alright?!
Sir, we have destroyed the enemies and liberated\nthe castle!
Dunkelis and Sir Halios are here.\nPlease respond!!
I must say thank you, adventurers.\nThe Dark Realm would have been conquered by\nthe enemies without your help.
It was lucky that I could save you from danger.\nI didn't think you could do such a great job\nlike this though... I appreciate your help.
Anyway... What exactly were the black crystals and\ndeformed monsters that attacked the Dark Realm\nthis time...
We manged to defeat the troops of the black\ncrystals but we couldn't get any clues about\nthem.
...I could say the crystals that possessed the\nmonsters in the world beyond here should be the\nsame as the ones that attacked here.
And they are intelligent life that tries to\nproliferate...
I'll go to the shrine of the Twelve Gods, which\nlies in a secluded space, and report to Almas\nand other gods to discuss countermeasures.
Vatendeth, Halios. I'll leave the defense in the\nDark Realm to you.\nGrecia, give them support.
Yes, ma'am!!
Understood!
Oh, really?\nYou can go back to Noieverre and plan the defense\nwith the souls...?
I appreciate it.
Please tell them that we, Army of Darkness may\nneed your cooperation depending on the situation...
I want you to go back to the human world and\nprevent the spread of the black crystals,\nand find out their purposes...
I assume that the unstable situation in the\nhuman world could get worse if the Dark Realm\nand Noieverre intervened since the world is
not given enough divine protection from the\n12 gods.\nSo, could you do that?
You can go back to your world from the Dark\nWasteland. But... the remnants of the black\ncrystals may be there. So, please stay alert.
Thank you for defeating the unknown intruders,\nnot only saving Dunkelis... I'm proud that I could\nsave you at Lunagent Mountain...
The black crystals intrude a world behind the\nscenes at first. Then suddenly, they start\na brutal invasion.
Please spread the information after going back to\nthe world and prepare for the time...
What? Dissolution?
I stopped your dissolution just a little while\nago, so you'll be safe while you are going back\nto your world from the Dark Wasteland.
Watch your step.
Hey, Hydra said it was emergency but it was\nall settled down when I arrived.
Burnos and Zolban also helped you, right?\nI must say thank you on behalf of them.
You're a great human. I expect you'll play an\nimportant role in your world. Oh, yea. Call me\nif something you can't handle occurs there.
I'll fly to you. Don't forget it.\nTake care.
Thanks to your help, the whole Dark Realm was\nsaved, not only we and Dunkelis.\nI appreciate it...
The black crystals will attack people in your\nworld in future. You may encounter a situation\nthat you and your friends can't resolve.
Then, you can call us. My big brother said the\nsame thing though.\nDo not hesitate to call us. Understood?
Adventurer, you did a great job.\nWell, I felt excited like when I was peddling in\nthe world beyond here.
I'd like to stay with you for a little longer...\nBut, it's time to say goodbye.
...What? Why, you ask? I'm the manager of the\nGarden of Beginning and one of the souls that\nis waiting for the next life in the Dark Realm.
I miss you but I can't keep going with you from\nhere...
Oh, please don't look sad like that.\nThat makes me feel so lonely...
Oh, well.\nPlease say hello to my offspring after going back\nto there.
You know her well!\nShe's slick and always thinking about her own\ninterests first but she's not a bad girl...
Then, see you somewhere again.\nTake care!
